items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: They played like things like Nelson Eddy. Remember Nelson Eddy?

ctx.x: Yeah. It was like 1902 or something. And I said, “Cutters?” “Sleigh in the snow, yeah oh yeah.” I said, “Well what kind of band was it.” “Oh harp and violin and maybe some mandolin or something.” Like then they played old music man. They played like turn of the century music. And they were older. My father was older and they played like things like Nelson Eddy. Remember Nelson Eddy?
